metadata.title: WeatherBridge: training and evaluation code for global weather interpolation
metadata.description: Training, evaluation, testing and figure-generation code for WeatherBridge and the comparison architectures used in the accompanying study of global weather interpolation at held-out query times. The archive contains Hydra configurations, environment locks, synthetic tests and provenance utilities. Datasets and trained checkpoints are distributed separately.
